scenes.headline: How a pocket model learned to rewrite image prompts
scenes.sub: Qwen-Image-2.1's 9B prompt rewriter, distilled into a 0.8B and a 2B.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Pear! Qwen-Image-2.1 wants a big model to rewrite every request. Two small students learned that job.

scenes.label: What's new
scenes.text: The pocket models answer with no system prompt and no thinking. The instructions and the JSON format are in the weights.
scenes.say: The pocket models skip the system prompt and the thinking. It's all in the weights.

steps.say: You type a short request. The rewriter reads it first.
It returns one line of JSON: a long picture description and an aspect ratio.

steps.note: 34 text tokens as typed; 446 from the 0.8B
steps.say: That description joins the sequence all thirty-two blocks process: thirty-four tokens as typed, four hundred and forty-six from the small rewriter.
Without a prefix cache, every denoising step pays for it: about one point four times the cost.

left.title: The 9B teacher
left.say: The teacher reads a long system prompt, then thinks for about eight hundred tokens.

right.title: The pocket students
right.say: The students get no system prompt. Their template closes the think block.

items.say: A small model wrote eight thousand seven hundred and ninety-seven synthetic requests.
A hard filter kept rewrites of eighty to four hundred words.
The students trained on the survivors, two epochs.

scenes.title: Share of requests that reached training
scenes.note: The students saw 11 posters and 5 app screens
scenes.say: That word limit chose the curriculum. About seventy percent of stickers and logos got in, almost no posters or screens.

scenes.title: One poster request, four prompts
scenes.credit: ML-Intern-lab distillation dataset, contact sheet r03071

steps.say: One poster request, rendered four ways: as typed, and from each rewriter. One seed each.
Only the teacher's rewrite put the title on the poster.
The students had seen eleven posters. Their rewrites gave cityscapes with no text.

scenes.label: Checks the four test requests define
scenes.note: one draw per arm, four prompts, on four CPU cores
scenes.say: On four test renders, typed requests passed seven of nine checks. The small rewriter's passed one.

scenes.text: The students copied the teacher's format, not yet its effect on pictures, and every rewrite lengthens the denoiser's work.
scenes.mark: not yet its effect on pictures
scenes.say: The students copied the teacher's format, not yet its effect on pictures. And every rewrite lengthens the denoiser's work.

recap: A rewriter turns a request into JSON
Students learned it with no prompt, no thinking
scenes.say: A rewriter describes the picture. The students learned it without a prompt. A word limit chose their lessons.
